card.name: Digits just before a decimal or percent
card.fires_on: The first digit or separator in a number inside a statistic, right before a decimal point, percent sign or range end. Seen in clinical trial results such as incidence rates, ranges and risk tables.

modes.label: Digit in percent or range
modes.description: A digit or space inside a percentage or range value in trial results.

modes.label: Gap or bracket before a number
modes.description: A space or open bracket just before a small percentage figure.

modes.label: Other separators
modes.description: A dot or table bar before a file extension or value in non-drug text.
